title: Schedule of Carry Shares by How Long Ago a Booking Was Given Up — Air Ticket Fare Brands
content:
Footnote to the travel credit lines of the Air Ticket Fare Brands tariff, qualifying by how long the booking has stood given up the share taken on the value standing. The age is counted in whole calendar months from the day the booking's cancellation was confirmed to the handling date.

- Where the booking's cancellation was confirmed longer ago than the long-stale term of 12 months, the value standing is taken at 0.70.
- Where the booking's cancellation was confirmed longer ago than the mid-stale term of 6 months but not longer ago than the long-stale term of 12 months, the value standing is taken at 0.85.
- Otherwise the value standing is taken in full.

Read as one line: an age greater than 12 months takes the value standing at 0.70; an age greater than 6 months and no greater than 12 months takes it at 0.85; an age of 6 months or less takes the value standing in full.

**Both sides of each term.** A cancellation confirmed 13 months before the handling date is longer ago than 12 months, and the value standing is taken at 0.70. A cancellation confirmed exactly 12 months before that date is not longer ago than the long-stale term, so the value standing is taken at 0.85. A cancellation confirmed 7 months before the handling date is longer ago than the mid-stale term, and the value standing is likewise taken at 0.85. A cancellation confirmed exactly 6 months before that date is not longer ago than the mid-stale term, and the value standing is taken in full.
